title: console list page: a list_toolbar action that acts on a selection leaves the page header for the selection bar — the bar floats when rows are selected, next to the view's bulkActions, and the header keeps only New, Import and the ⋯
body:
Ruled: 6190946913 · letter A-narrow · 2026-10-15T11:26Z

Filing gate ③, on the maintainer's word (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill): after the post-merge screenshots the maintainer said 「和你的设计图差距还是比较大，后续还有哪些任务你给我具体解释一下」, the seat listed the remaining gaps, and the maintainer answered 「同意开卡」. The design is the main board of the reference page https://claude.ai/artifact/JCzrzHxTxzD4EEKCTtDaNA (`main-1440.png`; the prototype's interaction note: 「选中后底部浮出批量操作条：Add to Campaign / Change Owner / Delete；页头不再常驻 Add to Campaign」).

Parent: #12444. Blocks nothing; nothing blocks it. Shares `ObjectView.tsx` (the header actions region, lines 3964–3972) and `ListView.tsx` with #12440 (the tab strip region and the toolbar row): different regions, dispatchable in parallel; the second to land merges `main` again.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch, one dev round across `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, size M. No `packages/spec` change: the keys this card reads exist.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T08:58Z): "bulk action bar floating selection bar list_toolbar actions move when rows selected Add to Campaign change owner delete" → 3, all closed: #12105 (a promoted action's param on the selection bar), #3056 (bulk delete leaves checkboxes ticked), #751 (the original BulkActions bar). None is this card; #12105 shows the selection bar already carries promoted actions, which is the mechanism this card extends.

## The problem

On the Leads list, "Add to Campaign" is a `list_toolbar` action the HotCRM app declares, and the console draws it permanently in the page header beside New and Import, whatever is selected. It acts on records, so with nothing selected it is a button that leads to a picker, and with rows selected it is far from them. The design draws it where the records are: a bar that floats at the bottom when rows are selected, carrying the view's `bulkActions` (Change Owner, Delete) and the selection-taking toolbar actions; the header keeps New, Import and the ⋯.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `a8e5b73`, read 2026-10-15T08:58Z)

1. `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` lines 2022–2070 build `localizedToolbarActions` (the app's `list_toolbar` actions, `actionRendersAt(a, 'list_toolbar')`); lines 3964–3972 draw them in the page header through `SchemaRenderer schema={toolbarBar}` (or `EnvironmentListToolbar` on the environment list).
2. `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` lines 83–87 and 3359–3464: the grid's selection bar is `components/BulkActionBar.tsx`, fed by `resolveBulkActions` from the view's `bulkActions` (`packages/types/src/objectql.ts` 651–713: names resolved against `objectDef.actions` and promoted; the four-layer gate of objectui#12082); `resolvePromotedBulkParams` handles a promoted action's params (objectui#12105).
3. `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` lines 1902–1957: the non-grid views' own bulk bar, gated the same way (`permittedBulkActions`, `partitionBulkRows`).
4. The action shape in `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` and `objectql.ts` line 2411 carries the selection scope an action declares (the dev names the exact key in the PR; it is read, not minted).

## What to build

1. A `list_toolbar` action whose declaration says it acts on a selection is not drawn in the page header. It is drawn in the selection bar when one or more rows are selected, after the view's `bulkActions`, through the same promotion path those use (`resolveBulkActions` / the promoted-params handling of objectui#12105), so its gate, its confirm step and its params behave as a declared bulk action's do. An action with no selection scope stays in the header as today.
2. The grid's `BulkActionBar` and the non-grid views' bar both take these actions; one shared derivation, no second table.
3. The header's action row is New, Import (the app's non-selection actions) and the ⋯ (#12427). Nothing in HotCRM's metadata changes: the demo's "Add to Campaign" is the instance this is measured on.

## Acceptance

- `ObjectView` test: an app declaring one selection-scoped and one plain `list_toolbar` action renders only the plain one in the header; with one row selected the selection bar lists the view's `bulkActions` and then the selection-scoped action, in that order; the action's gate (objectui#12082's four layers) is applied to the selected rows, not skipped.
- `ListView` test: a non-grid view (kanban) shows the same bar with the same roster on selection.
- Browser reading by the landing seat at 1440 on the HotCRM Leads list: the header reads New · Import · ⋯; selecting two rows floats a bar with Change Owner · Delete · Add to Campaign (whatever the demo's `bulkActions` declare, then the toolbar action); clearing the selection hides it.
- `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; a changeset (minor) for each published package touched.

## Out of scope

- New bulk actions or any HotCRM metadata; the bar's look beyond placement (it is the existing `BulkActionBar`); a spec key for the scope (the existing one is read).

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's words quoted above.
